_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: "People is" thay vì "people are" (o povo é là số ít)
mistake.l1: Portuguese “o povo é / a gente é” is singular.

segments.text: Don't say, people is nice. Say, people are nice.
In English, people means more than one person, so we use are.
Repeat after me. People are nice here.
Great job! People are, never people is.

native.caption: Em português se diz “o povo é”, mas em inglês “people” ({m:people}) é sempre plural: “people are”. Diga “People are nice”, nunca “people is”. Repita com a Ama e pratique gramática no app Lexkite.

en.caption: In Portuguese you say “o povo é”, but in English “people” ({m:people}) is always plural: “people are”. Say “People are nice”, never “people is”. Repeat with Ama and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
